man bending beside a discard carton
cards.visible_setting: A lived-in home study corner during a clear-out, with an open wooden desk drawer and a plain discard carton.
cards.observable_action: A worn unlabelled folder has just landed in the carton. The woman's right hand has withdrawn from it while the man retrieves the folder edge.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's left hand is supported on the drawer edge. The man's right hand meets the folder edge through a visible wrist and forearm; his left hand rests on his own thigh.
cards.gaze: The woman looks toward the open drawer and the man looks only at the folder.
cards.body_blocking: Their bodies remain separated across the frame; she faces the drawer while his torso angles toward the carton.
cards.object_state: The folder is leaving the discard carton in the man's right hand.
cards.camera_view: Low box-level wide view from a slight three-quarter angle.
cards.visible_continuity: The folder begins discarded and ends rescued.

visible_people: the same woman, shown through lower torso, knee and connected left forearm
the same man, shown through lower torso, knee and connected left forearm
cards.visible_setting: Floor-level space beside the same desk and carton.
cards.observable_action: The rescued folder lies open between them. Several dog-eared unfinished paper forms fan out while the woman begins to draw the cover shut.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's left hand rests on the folder cover. The man's left hand remains attached to the folder spine without tugging. All other hands are outside frame.
cards.body_blocking: Their knees sit on opposite sides of the open folder with clear space around the papers.
cards.object_state: The folder is open but becoming half-closed; its contents show erased marks, blank-line layouts, rough boxes and folded sheets with no readable words.
cards.camera_view: Tactile close insert at floor level.
cards.visible_continuity: The rescued folder has been opened and its contents exposed.

visible_people: the same man seated on one side of the paper line
cards.visible_setting: The same floor or low table, viewed directly from above.
cards.observable_action: The man lays four or five visually distinct, non-readable sheets into a clean left-to-right progression while the woman watches.
cards.hands_and_contact: Both of the man's hands are visible and attached, each arranging one sheet. The woman's left hand rests on her own knee; her right hand is outside frame.
cards.gaze: Both direct their attention toward the developing line of papers.
cards.body_blocking: They occupy opposite sides of the chronology, which spans the space between them.
cards.object_state: Loose papers with subtly different wear are now arranged from more worn to fresher.
cards.visible_continuity: The loose contents have become one ordered line.

visible_people: the same woman in clear focus
the same man's shoulder and partial profile in the foreground
cards.visible_setting: The same study corner with the ordered papers between them.
cards.observable_action: The woman's hand has released the folder cover and opened it flat beside the chronology. Her guarded posture softens into a quiet half-smile.
cards.hands_and_contact: Only the woman's right hand is visible, open and resting beside the papers. The man's hands remain outside frame.
cards.gaze: The woman's gaze rests on the ordered papers; the man's partial profile is oriented toward her and the papers.
cards.body_blocking: The paper line leads from the man's foreground shoulder toward the woman's face. They do not touch.
cards.object_state: The folder is now fully open and the paper line remains intact.
cards.visible_continuity: The woman is no longer closing the folder.

visible_people: the same woman leaning into the foreground action
the same man beside her, watching
cards.visible_setting: The same low table or floor plane with the open folder and ordered row.
cards.observable_action: The woman slides a fresh, visibly unfinished but wordless page into the open final gap while the man watches without directing her.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand pushes the new page and her left hand steadies the folder edge, both attached through visible wrists and forearms. The man's hands are outside frame.
cards.gaze: Both gazes converge on the newly added page.
cards.body_blocking: The woman owns the foreground action; the man stays close beside her without touching the page.
cards.object_state: The open folder sits behind the ordered line, which now ends with the fresh page.
cards.camera_view: Low table-level close two-shot with hand action in the foreground.
cards.visible_continuity: A new current page extends the previously ordered archive.
